text:
alex_dev: Ran into a flaky hang when cancelling an async stream from the Python SDK. Repro is small.

alex_dev: minimal repro: 
```py
async def gen_one(client):
    async for c in client.chat.stream(model="rwd-2", prompt="hi"):
        return c

g = gen_one(client)
await anext(g)  # get first chunk
await g.aclose()  # sometimes returns but socket persists
```

alex_dev: Intermittent (~1/25) the process shows an open HTTP fd and asyncio has a waiting task. Cancelling the awaiting task yields CancelledError but underlying httpx stream task lingers.

maria_sdk: what sdk version + logs?

alex_dev: py-sdk 0.7.3. Snippet from debug log: 
```
INFO:root:start stream id=rz-9
ERROR:asyncio:Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File ".../redwood_sdk/stream.py", line 118, in _reader
    async for part in resp.aiter_text():
asyncio.exceptions.CancelledError
```

alex_dev: After that I don't see resp.aclose() in logs; GC doesn't collect the transport.

tim_infra: sounds like our wrapper swallows CancelledError inside an internal task, keeping a reference to resp. We had related SSE vs chunked edge-cases where aiter_text won't exit until socket EOF.

olivia_support: customers will hit this if connections pile up. Any easy workaround?

maria_sdk: we have `async with client.chat.stream(...) as it:` context manager and explicit `try: ... finally: await it.aclose()` patterns. Recommend `async with` for now.

alex_dev: `async with` helps but doesn't cover external task.cancel() races. I can force `await client.close()` and that kills the socket but that's not workable for library users who keep client alive.

maria_sdk: good signal. We recently changed generator finalizer to use weakref.finalize to call aclose(); that might race with manual aclose() and tasks. I'll audit the stream wrapper.

alex_dev: also noticed types.pyi for StreamIterator types __anext__ -> str but we sometimes yield dicts (structured chunks). Typing mismatch may hide codepaths.

maria_sdk: will relax typing to allow Mapping/Any. For the leak: plan is 1) ensure internal reader task propagates CancelledError and calls resp.aclose() in finally, 2) make finalizer idempotent, 3) add regression test that cancels tasks rapidly, 4) add debug env var for stream to log aclose calls.

tim_infra: I'll help add an httpx transport test and stress test that cancels 100x.

maria_sdk: assigning bug to me + tim. I'll open a draft PR with failing test and instrumentation.

ci-bot: created issue redwood/sdk#1427 (stream-cancel-leak) and linked PR draft.

alex_dev: happy to run the branch against my app for smoke. Thanks for quick triage.

maria_sdk: please do. Also try setting `REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG_STREAM=1` to capture httpx traces and include them in the issue. We'll push a patch release after tests pass. :thumbsup:
